title: Synthesize a positive target channel from finitely many calibrated proxy records
statement: For known rational L with distinct columns and strictly positive finite K,empirical nearest-column classification has confusion C_r->I. For eta=||C_r-I||_1<1 and eta/(1-eta)<min K_yx,V=K C_r^-1 is stochastic and V C_r=K,so a finite iid block has zero raw disclosure.

requires: Known rational distinct L columns and strictly positive K
Persistent classical X and enough iid repetitions for the actual exact positivity certificate
provides: Finite exact target simulation by ordinary classifier and garbling
assumptions: Only Y leaves the module;private proxy records,degree,count,flags,raw values and memory are discarded.
An already-classical X persists throughout the block;coherent input or state-changing detector access is not acquired.
No uniform polynomial bound in growing alphabet or channel bit length
A joint-channel LP may improve repetition count with the same observations
costs: Charge every actual cheap/raw disclosure,calibration,preparation/reset,input lifetime,entropy,storage,latency and arithmetic. Equally informed ordinary classifiers,factories,common-part splitting and one-read caching receive the same resources. No measured complete-resource advantage.
contract.units: Dimensionless column-stochastic probabilities and total variation;cheap-call/raw-disclosure counts,internal random bits and bit operations remain separate. Physical source units,calibration,lifetime and costs require acquisition.
contract.obstruction: This is ordinary classification/garbling,not a new complexity result or specially acquired source.
